results.name: Plank Lunges
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Bring your right knee forward and place your right foot outside your right hand, keeping your left leg extended straight back.
Return your right foot to the plank position.
Repeat the movement with your left knee, bringing your left foot forward to place it outside your left hand. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move your leg slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you bring your foot forward and inhaling as you return to the plank position.
Ensure your body stays in a straight line, avoiding sagging hips or raised buttocks.
results.description: Plank Lunges is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Plank Pushup
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other, until you are in a high plank.
Lower back to one forearm, then the other.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.
tips: Keep your hips from rocking.
Widen your feet for more stability.
results.description: Plank Pushup is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

results.name: Plate Overhead Carry
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with both hands, arms locked out.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Continue for the set distance or time, then lower the plate with control.
tips: Keep your ribs down; don't arch your lower back.
Keep the plate directly over your head.
results.description: Plate Overhead Carry is an intermediate multi-joint compound loaded carry exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Traps, Upper Back.

results.name: Pull Sled or Dog Sled Push
instructions: Grip the sled handles with your arms extended.
Lean forward with a flat back.
Drive the sled forward with powerful steps.
Continue for the set distance.
tips: Brace your core.
Keep your steps short and fast.
results.description: Pull Sled or Dog Sled Push is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Hamstrings, Shoulders.

results.name: Pushup to Renegade Row
instructions: Start in a high plank holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
Do a push-up.
At the top, row one dumbbell to your hip, then lower it.
Row the other dumbbell, then go into the next push-up.
tips: Widen your feet to stop your hips from rotating.
Use hex dumbbells so they don't roll.
results.description: Pushup to Renegade Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Lats, Core.

results.name: Rebounder High Knee Runs
instructions: Stand in the middle of a rebounder trampoline.
Run on the spot, driving your knees up toward hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep going for the set time.
tips: Stay in the centre of the mat.
Stand tall.
results.description: Rebounder High Knee Runs is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Core.

results.name: Rebounder Knee Jumps
instructions: Stand in the middle of a rebounder trampoline.
Bounce, then jump and bring both knees up toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Repeat in a steady rhythm.
tips: Use your arms to help the jump.
Land in the centre of the mat.
results.description: Rebounder Knee Jumps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Abdominals, Glutes.

results.name: Rebounder Knee Pushes
instructions: Kneel beside a rebounder and place your hands on the mat in a kneeling push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the mat.
Press up quickly using the rebound of the mat.
Repeat in a steady rhythm.
tips: Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
results.description: Rebounder Knee Pushes is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Rebounder Light Jumps
instructions: Stand in the middle of a rebounder trampoline with your feet hip-width apart.
Bounce gently, keeping your feet close to the mat.
Keep your knees soft and your core engaged.
Continue for the set time.
tips: A good warm-up; keep it easy.
Stay in the centre of the mat.
results.description: Rebounder Light Jumps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Core.

results.name: Rebounder in & Out From Ground
instructions: Stand next to a rebounder.
Step or jump onto the mat, bounce once, and step or jump back to the ground.
Alternate the lead foot.
Continue for the set time.
tips: Make sure the rebounder is stable.
Land softly each time.
results.description: Rebounder in & Out From Ground is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Core.
